title: What It Actually Looks Like to Let a Younger Man Correct You
caption:
The second a younger guy points at something in you, the instinct is to explain why he's missing context. That's not wisdom. That's pride buying time.

More years walking with God doesn't mean fewer blind spots, just better excuses for the ones you've kept. Nathan wasn't a general. He was a prophet with one line and no leverage, and David still knelt.

The size of the man doesn't shrink the size of the truth. The guy secure enough to hear it isn't the guy with the least to prove. He's the guy who already knows who he's under.

#faith #humility #godlyman #christianmen #correction
